career_ladder.note: Administrative Officers (AO) and Finance & Accounts Officers (FAO) are the premier administrative and financial executive cadre recruited through national competitive examination conducted by the Agricultural Scientists Recruitment Board (ASRB) for the Indian Council of Agricultural Research (ICAR) and its 64+ national institutes across India. Appointed to Group 'A' Junior Scale (Pay Level 10), officers manage institute general administration, scientific personnel management, legal affairs, procurement, research grants, and financial comptrollership, progressing to Senior Administrative Officer, Chief Administrative Officer, and Joint Secretary at ICAR Headquarters.

exam_scheme.note: The Combined Examination for Administrative Officer (AO) and Finance & Accounts Officer (FAO) conducted by ASRB consists of a three-tier selection process: Tier I (Computer Based Preliminary Screening Examination), Tier II (Descriptive Mains Examination of 4 Papers), and Tier III (Structured Interview / Personality Test).

stages.source_label: ASRB Notification — Scheme of Tier II Mains Examination

papers.paper_name: Paper I: General Awareness (History, Geography, Indian Polity, Economy, Agriculture & Rural Development)
Paper II: Essay Writing (75 marks) + English/Hindi Language & Comprehension (75 marks)
Paper III: Specialized Subject Paper (General Administration & Public Administration for AO; Commerce & Financial Management for FAO)
Paper IV: Ethics, Integrity and Aptitude
papers.negative_marking: Descriptive case studies and ethical principles

papers.negative_marking: Evaluation of executive leadership, decision-making, and administrative competence
papers.qualifying_threshold: Final merit drawn out of 700 marks (Tier II 600 marks + Tier III 100 marks)

financial_package.pay_source_label: ASRB Notification No. 02(02)/2021-Exam-I — Pay Matrix Level 10 (₹56,100 - ₹1,77,500)
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated based on 7th CPC Level 10 entry basic pay of ₹56,100 (Group A Gazetted). Dearness Allowance at canonical 58% equals ₹32,538. House Rent Allowance ranges from ₹5,610 (10% in Z-class rural ICAR stations) to ₹16,830 (30% in X-class cities like ICAR Headquarters/IARI Pusa, New Delhi). Transport Allowance for Level 10 is ₹7,200 + 58% DA = ₹11,376 in higher TPTA cities (or ₹3,600 + DA = ₹5,688 in other cities). Monthly deductions include National Pension System (10% of Basic + DA = ₹8,864), CGHS, and income tax.
official_perks: Allotted Type-V / Type-IV central government institutional residential quarters at ICAR institute campuses or HRA
Transport Allowance and official staff vehicle access for official and administrative duties
Comprehensive medical coverage under Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS) or ICAR Medical Attendance Rules
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and annual leave encashment provisions
Defined contribution benefits under National Pension System (NPS) with 14% government contribution and Central Government Gratuity
Children Education Allowance (CEA) and annual professional book grant
